headline: The Dashboard and usage-analytics area covers six items all marked ready for release; code was found supporting the AI usage-habits analysis, the AI cost-saving recommendation with one-click apply, and the currency picker, while the three items covering usage/cost summary figures, stat cards and the trend chart could not be confirmed from the code that was reviewed.
what_is_there: The code shows a dashboard screen that exists and is built on demand, with an AI feature that summarises a user's token usage (including busiest day and hour) and another that recommends and applies a cost-saving strategy, plus a display-currency selector that saves the user's choice and reformats costs accordingly.
what_is_unclear: The parts of the dashboard that display token usage totals, the cost overview with today/week/month/all filtering, the individual stat cards and the usage-trend chart were not settled — the files that would contain those screen elements were not among the ones examined, so this is a gap in the review rather than evidence the features are absent. The exact list of supported currencies (VND/USD/JPY) also sits in a section of code that wasn't shown.
suggested_action: Ask whoever owns the dashboard to demo the usage stats, period filter, stat cards and trend chart so the three unconfirmed items can be signed off from the running product.
